newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide to issue 2.5 bln-peso long-term debt.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide to issue 2.5 bln-peso long-term debt.

text.p: Philippine retailer Uniwide Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board approved the issuance of 2.5 billion pesos worth of long-term commercial papers.
In the same disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, it said its board also decided to raise the franchise fee for all Uniwide Warehouse Clubs to two from one percent of net sales.

The company said the increase in fees, which was made in consultations with franchisees, would result in an increase in franchise fees by about 150 million pesos this year. It gave no estimate of what revenues from the fees would be.
The funds from the increase in fees will be used to accelerate the construction of additional warehouse clubs nationwide, Uniwide said.
The proceeds of the long-term commercial paper issue will also be used to finance expansion and retire debt.
